title: The Thomas Crown Affair
overview: A debonair, adventuresome man believes he has pulled off the perfect multi-million dollar heist, only to match wits with an insurance investigator who will do anything to get her man.

title: Gatto
overview: After years of maneuvering the canal-ridden, superstitious city of Venice, Italy, a scrappy black cat named Nero begins to question whether he’s lived the right lives. Indebted to Rocco, a ruthless local feline mob boss, Nero finds himself in a quandary and is forced to forge a truly unexpected friendship that may finally lead him to his purpose—unless Venice gets the better of him first.

title: The Exorcist: Martyrs
overview: Thirteen years ago, New York City detective Julie Miller ended the terror reign of satanic serial killer Father Sunday. The case made her a hero, and she has thrown herself into her work ever since. Now a new killer scrawls her name in an altar boy's blood on the walls of a church crypt, dragging her back into the darkness she believed she had buried with him.

title: The Nightingale
overview: The lives of two French sisters are torn apart by the onset of World War II.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog 4
overview: When a new threat emerges from a fractured timeline, Team Sonic find themselves facing an adventure unlike anything they've encountered before. With the Chaos Emeralds scattered across different periods in time, Sonic—alongside new friends and old—must journey through the past, present, and future to recover them before a dangerous alternate timeline becomes reality.

title: The Riders
overview: Fred Scully is a family man who has bought a farmhouse in Ireland and is renovating it while his wife Jennifer and their 7-year-old daughter Billie are on a trip to their homeland in Australia. After his wife disappears during the trip, Fred and his traumatized daughter and must travel across Europe searching for answers.

title: Godzilla x Kong: Supernova
overview: Godzilla and Kong return in an all-new adventure as Earth's greatest titans face an unthinkable threat from beyond the stars. When an Apex cosmic predator sets its sights on Earth, only the combined might of monsters and humanity can avert total extinction.
